patch.role: Recomputes the loop-carried line accumulator from the remaining chunks instead of applying the decrement.

inputs.mask_two_lines: two-line truncation where the last line ends in a dropped whitespace chunk
inputs.expose_three_lines: three-line truncation with the same dropped-chunk shape
inputs.control_line_fits: the candidate line fits even without the decrement
inputs.control_no_max_lines: max_lines is None; cur_len is not consulted

rationale: A adjusts the per-line accumulator when a trailing whitespace chunk is dropped; U1 rebuilds the accumulator from the surviving chunks.  The rebuild is declared for two-line truncation, which is the masking input; three-line truncation exposes the deletion.
